name: Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator
author: Dave

sections.description:
Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator is a Dutch-language WordPress plugin for manually creating AI-assisted blog content directly from the WordPress dashboard.

The plugin is specifically designed for Dutch-language WordPress websites. The plugin interface is in Dutch and the generated blog titles and articles are written in Dutch.

The plugin works as a standalone plugin and does not require a paid Dave Gerrits license. To generate content, you use your own OpenAI API key.

Blog Title Generator

Enter a topic and let the plugin generate 10 Dutch-language blog title ideas.

You can select one of the generated titles and send it directly to the Blog Generator. The selected title is automatically filled into the blog title field, so you do not have to copy and paste it manually.

The article itself is not generated automatically. You remain in control and manually start article generation from the Blog Generator.

Blog Generator

Enter a blog title, optionally provide additional instructions and choose the desired article length. You can also save one optional writing style in the Blog Generator. This saved style is automatically applied to future generated articles until you change or remove it.

The plugin then generates a Dutch-language article with a clear HTML structure:

  • Exactly one H1 heading
  • Logical H2 headings
  • H3 headings where appropriate
  • Clearly structured paragraphs
  • A readable article structure

The generated article is displayed as a formatted preview. With the copy button, you can copy the article and then paste it manually into the WordPress editor.

After article generation, the plugin also automatically prepares SEO data that you can use with your article. The meta description is limited to a maximum of 140 characters.

This free plugin does not automatically schedule, generate or publish articles. You start every generation request manually and decide what to do with the generated content.

Always review AI-generated content for accuracy before publishing.

Use your own OpenAI API key

Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator uses your own OpenAI API key.

In the settings, you can configure your API key and the AI model you want to use. A built-in connection test lets you verify that the connection to OpenAI is working.

Use of the OpenAI API may result in charges from OpenAI according to the terms and pricing of your own OpenAI account.

Looking for more automation?

In addition to this free manual AI Content Generator, Dave Gerrits also offers Content AI Agent: a more advanced commercial WordPress plugin for Dutch-language content and content automation.

Content AI Agent includes additional and advanced features such as:

  • Planning content weeks or months ahead
  • Automatically generating and publishing articles
  • Automatically filling SEO data in supported workflows when using Yoast SEO or Rank Math
  • Automatically generating high-quality AI featured images for articles
  • Generating content ideas
  • Building content clusters with the Content Cluster Planner
  • Using multiple writing style profiles
  • Creating different content types, including posts, pages and WooCommerce descriptions
  • Rewriting existing articles
  • Optimizing existing content
  • Generating FAQ content
  • Processing and rewriting RSS content
  • Advanced queues and content automation
  • Analyzing your website for internal linking opportunities
  • Adding smart internal links

More information about Content AI Agent:
https://davegerrits.nl/content-ai-agent/

External services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API to generate Dutch-language blog articles and blog title ideas.

When you manually start a generation request, the plugin sends the information required for that request to OpenAI. This may include the blog title, topic, additional instructions, your saved writing style and requested article length.

Data is sent to OpenAI only when you manually start a content generation request or when you use the built-in OpenAI connection test.

The connection to OpenAI uses the API key that you enter in the plugin settings. AI requests are sent directly to OpenAI and are not routed through a Dave Gerrits server.

This external service is provided by OpenAI.

OpenAI Services Agreement:
https://openai.com/policies/services-agreement/

OpenAI Service Terms:
https://openai.com/policies/service-terms/

OpenAI Privacy Policy:
https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

By using the OpenAI API, you are responsible for complying with OpenAI’s terms and privacy policy.

Source code and build process

All custom source code required to use and modify this plugin is included directly in the plugin package.

The JavaScript and CSS files in the assets directory are human-readable source files. This plugin does not use npm, webpack or another external build process, and there are no separate compiled or minified distribution files required to build the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through WordPress or upload the dave-gerrits-ai-content-generator folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator settings.
  4. Enter your own OpenAI API key.
  5. Choose the AI model if desired.
  6. Save the settings.
  7. Use the connection test to verify the OpenAI connection.
  8. Open the Blog Title Generator or Blog Generator to manually generate content.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin Dutch-language only?

Yes. Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator is developed for Dutch-language WordPress websites. The plugin interface is in Dutch and the generated content is written in Dutch.

Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes. The plugin uses your own OpenAI API key to generate blog titles and articles.

Is this plugin free to use?

Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator does not require a paid Dave Gerrits license. OpenAI may charge for API usage through your own OpenAI account.

Can I send a generated blog title directly to the Blog Generator?

Yes. Since version 1.1.0, you can select one of the 10 generated blog titles and use the “Use selected title” button. The title is then automatically filled into the Blog Generator.

Can I generate complete blog articles?

Yes. You can enter a blog title, optionally provide additional instructions and choose the desired article length. The plugin then generates a complete Dutch-language article.

Can I save a writing style?

Yes. Since version 1.1.0, you can save one optional writing style in the Blog Generator. The saved style is automatically used for future generated articles. The free plugin does not include multiple writing style profiles.

Does the generated article contain headings?

Yes. The output uses one H1 heading, logical H2 headings and H3 headings where appropriate.

Does the plugin prepare SEO data?

Yes. After generating an article, the plugin automatically prepares SEO data that you can directly use with the article. The meta description is limited to a maximum of 140 characters.

Is the generated article automatically added to WordPress?

No. The generated article is displayed as a formatted preview. You copy the article with the copy button and then paste it manually into the WordPress editor.

Does this plugin automatically schedule or publish articles?

No. Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator is intended for manual content generation. Automatic planning, generation and publishing are available in the more advanced Content AI Agent plugin.

Should I review AI-generated content before publishing?

Yes. Always review factual accuracy, spelling, links and suitability for your audience before publishing AI-generated content.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added title selection to the Blog Title Generator.
  • Added a button to send the selected title directly to the Blog Generator.
  • The selected title is automatically filled into the Blog Generator while article generation remains manual.
  • Added one optional saved writing style to the Blog Generator.
  • The saved writing style is automatically applied when generating new articles.
  • Added automatically prepared SEO data after article generation, including a meta description limited to 140 characters.
  • Added separate copy buttons for the meta title and meta description.
  • Improved the plugin dashboard and Support & Help documentation.
  • Added clearer information about the extended Content AI Agent plugin.
  • Added a WordPress.org review link on the plugin dashboard.
  • Updated the WordPress.org readme for version 1.1.0.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Added Blog Generator.
  • Added Blog Title Generator.
  • Added H1, H2 and H3 structure for generated articles.
  • Added formatted article preview.
  • Added copy functionality for use in the WordPress editor.
  • Added OpenAI API settings and connection test.
  • Added configurable AI model.
  • Added Support and Help page.
  • Added information about Content AI Agent.
